en.headline: 55th Hong Kong French Film Festival opens today at City Hall
en.dek: The Alliance Française event runs until 9 December with more than 50 films across eight venues, opening with Antonin Baudry’s two-part De Gaulle.
body: The Hong Kong French Film Festival returns for its 55th edition today, running from 11 November to 9 December and presented by Alliance Française de Hong Kong.

Organisers said the programme includes more than 50 films screened at eight venues across the city. It opens at Hong Kong City Hall with Antonin Baudry’s two-part biographical drama De Gaulle, starring Simon Abkarian as Charles de Gaulle, with the second part following on 13 November.

This year’s edition also marks the Hong Kong debut of Directors’ Fortnight Extended, bringing a selection from Cannes’ Directors’ Fortnight, with Artistic Director Julien Rejl travelling to the city. Amélie director Jean-Pierre Jeunet is scheduled to visit mid-month.

A new educational programme, Let’s Go to the Movies!, offers free screenings for students from primary to university level between 11 and 14 November, selected by local critic Clarence Tsui. Tickets went on sale in October via URBTIX and Broadway Circuit.

zh.headline: 第55屆香港法國電影節今日於大會堂開幕
zh.dek: 由香港法國文化協會主辦，活動至12月9日，於八個場地放映逾50部電影，開幕片為安托南·博德里的《戴高樂》。
body: 香港法國電影節今日展開第55屆，由11月11日至12月9日舉行，由香港法國文化協會主辦。
主辦方表示，節目涵蓋逾50部電影，於全港八個場地放映。開幕於香港大會堂，放映安托南·博德里執導、西蒙·阿布卡里安飾演戴高樂的傳記片《戴高樂》，第二部分於13日上映。
今屆亦是戛納電影節導演雙周精選首次在港登場，藝術總監朱利安·雷吉爾將到訪。導演尚-皮埃爾·熱內預計月中來港。
新設教育項目「我們去看電影！」於11至14日為中小學至大學學生提供免費放映，由本地影評人徐嘉麗挑選。門票已於10月透過城市售票網及百老匯院線發售。
